threat_actors.note: Publisher accounts whose skills were flagged. `skills` is a flag count, not an adjudicated malicious count; `flagged_rate` is the share of that publisher's flagged skills carrying a critical-severity hit. Summing these (703) does not yield a confirmed-malware total and must not be quoted as one.

notes: Ecosystem wild scan, not a recall benchmark. The corpus has no ground-truth labels and no per-item adjudication. All four metrics are undefined here and recorded as 0 by convention -- including `precision`, which previously held 751/1302 = 0.5768. That was a flagged count divided by another flagged count: 751 is the OpenClaw-only flag total. The 552 'confirmed' figure quoted elsewhere is reproducible from data/public-blacklist.json but is a publisher attribution, not a review -- all 552 belong to two accounts (354/354 and 198/198, none excluded) and all match the single rule ATR-2026-00121, while 125 other hits on that same rule are unconfirmed only because their publisher differs. Cite `breakdown.flagged_rate` for ecosystem context and nothing else.
